_comment: MOCK MANIFEST FOR LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. These tool names, descriptions and parameter schemas are hand-written and FICTIONAL. This is NOT the verified live Swiggy MCP tool list and must not be presented as such. Its purpose is to give the retrieval pipeline a realistically-shaped multi-server manifest to develop and benchmark against. Replace with a real manifest when you have access to one.
name: commerce-mock

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search for restaurants available for delivery, filtered by cuisine, rating, price range or delivery time.

cuisine.description: Cuisine type, e.g. Italian, North Indian, Chinese.

max_delivery_minutes.description: Only include restaurants delivering within this many minutes.

examples: find italian restaurants near me
cheap north indian delivery under 30 minutes

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description: Fetch the full menu of a specific restaurant, including dish names, prices, categories and availability.

category.description: Optional menu section filter, e.g. Desserts, Starters.

include_unavailable.description: Include dishes currently out of stock.

examples: show me the menu
what desserts do they have

tools.name: add_food_item_to_cart
tools.description: Add a dish from a restaurant menu to the food delivery cart, with quantity and customisation options.

customisations.description: Add-ons, e.g. extra cheese, no onion.

examples: add two butter naan to my order

tools.name: place_food_order
tools.description: Place the food delivery order for the current cart and start preparation and dispatch.
examples: place my order and pay with upi
checkout my food cart

tools.name: track_food_delivery
tools.description: Get live status and estimated arrival time for an in-progress food delivery order, including delivery partner location.
examples: where is my food
how long until my order arrives

tools.name: cancel_food_order
tools.description: Cancel a food delivery order that has not yet been dispatched, and request a refund if payment was already taken.
examples: cancel my order
i want to cancel and get my money back

instamart.description: Instant grocery and daily essentials delivery.

tools.name: search_grocery_products
tools.description: Search the instant grocery catalogue for packaged goods, fresh produce, dairy and household essentials by name, brand or category.

query.description: Product search text, e.g. paneer, atta, dish soap.

category.description: Catalogue category, e.g. Dairy, Fruits, Snacks.

examples: find amul butter
search for fresh tomatoes

tools.name: check_grocery_availability
tools.description: Check whether a grocery product is currently in stock at the nearest dark store and how soon it can be delivered.
examples: is this in stock near me
can you deliver milk right now

tools.name: add_grocery_to_basket
tools.description: Add a grocery product to the instant delivery basket with a chosen pack size and quantity.
examples: add one litre of milk to my basket

tools.name: checkout_grocery_basket
tools.description: Confirm and pay for the instant grocery basket, scheduling immediate or slotted delivery of the essentials.

delivery_slot.description: Requested slot, or 'now' for instant delivery.

examples: checkout my groceries
pay for my basket and deliver now

tools.name: reorder_grocery_essentials
tools.description: Recreate a previous grocery basket to repeat a routine essentials purchase without searching for each item again.
examples: buy the same groceries as last week
repeat my usual essentials

dineout.description: Restaurant table reservations and dine-in offers.

tools.name: discover_dineout_restaurants
tools.description: Discover restaurants accepting dine-in table bookings nearby, filtered by cuisine, ambience, distance and available discounts.
examples: rooftop places for dinner nearby
fine dining with a discount tonight

tools.name: check_table_availability
tools.description: Check which reservation time slots are free at a restaurant for a given date and party size before booking.
examples: do they have a table free at 8pm
what slots are open for six people

tools.name: book_restaurant_table
tools.description: Reserve a table at a restaurant for dine-in, confirming the date, time, party size and seating preference.
examples: book a table for four tonight at eight
reserve an outdoor table for my anniversary

tools.name: cancel_table_reservation
tools.description: Cancel an existing dine-in table reservation and release the held slot.
examples: cancel my table booking for tomorrow

tools.name: get_dineout_offers
tools.description: List active dine-in deals, prepaid vouchers and percentage discounts available at a restaurant or across an area.
examples: any deals at this restaurant
show me bank offers for dining out
